drivingQuestion: How can the mishna's shofar be gold-plated at its mouth when a baraita disqualifies that?
outcomeNote: Abaye restricts the mishna to plating away from the mouth

segments.he: וּפִיו מְצוּפֶּה זָהָב. וְהָתַנְיָא: צִיפָּהוּ זָהָב בִּמְקוֹם הַנָּחַת פִּיו — פָּסוּל, שֶׁלֹּא בִּמְקוֹם הַנָּחַת פִּיו — כָּשֵׁר! אֲמַר אַבָּיֵי: כִּי תְּנַן נָמֵי מַתְנִיתִין — שֶׁלֹּא בִּמְקוֹם הַנָּחַת פֶּה תְּנַן.
segments.en: § It was taught in the mishna: «And» the «mouth» of the shofar that was used on Rosh HaShana «was plated with gold.» The Gemara raises a difficulty: «But isn’t it taught» in a baraita: If a shofar «was plated with gold at the place where one puts his mouth,» it is «unfit» for blowing; if it was plated, but «not at the place where he puts his mouth,» it is «fit» for blowing? «Abaye said: When we learned» in the mishna «as well, we learned» that it referred «not to the place where one puts his mouth,» but a little above it.
